approved_at_semantics: Current artifact-establishment time under explicit operator approval; not DB creation, Collector execution, or historical approval time.
schema_sha256_method: SHA-256 of UTF-8 Python json.dumps(sorted(SELECT type,name,tbl_name,sql FROM sqlite_master), separators=(',', ':')), ensure_ascii=True.
git_head_semantics: Source HEAD at approval verification, before committing this evidence artifact; not proof of DB identity.
historical_gap_reason: No independent source-SHA chain connects the previous approved DB to the 2026-08-27 comparison backup source.
approval_scope: Continued use of the current production DB from this baseline onward.
Use the recorded current SHA and counts as the new operator-approved baseline.
Evaluate future Collector and Backup differences from this baseline.
approval_exclusions: Historical provenance completeness or retroactive approval of the 2026-08-27 backup source.
Absolute absence of historical manual writes.
evidence_note: Explicit operator decision to trust the current DB prospectively, not retroactive verification. Prior comparison-backup-to-current row reconciliation is reusable only while both file SHA values match. Production DB was opened read-only; no DB copy, repair, restore, Collector or Backup execution is authorized by this artifact.
future_reconciliation_rule: Preserve Collector pre-DB SHA, run result, post-DB SHA, Backup source SHA and destination SHA in a separate future implementation. This artifact alone does not implement that chain or provide a row-level baseline copy.
baseline_invalidation_conditions: A changed current DB SHA or count requires reconciliation before claiming equality with this baseline.
Integrity or foreign-key failure requires review.
Missing or conflicting evidence must not be inferred as VERIFIED.
